requests.description: Hold Up's recurring everyday protagonist: an ordinary, likeable modern man (the viewer's stand-in) who reacts big to small mysteries. The same face and body in every episode; only his outfit and accessories change with the story.

outfit.description: base outfit: everyday modern casual that reads instantly at phone size

requests.personality: relatable, curious, a little clumsy and easily startled, quick to grin; big readable reactions
requests.silhouette: instantly recognisable even in a different outfit or era: a tall, tousled dark-brown quiff that tips slightly forward (his signature shape, kept in every story), a slim build with slightly long arms, compact Hold Up proportions with a large head; one strong, muted teal jacket colour that reads against grey concrete and a red-and-white pump
requests.contrastWith: the cooper (approved 1870s craftsman): the protagonist must read as clearly modern and younger, with a different head shape, hair and palette
garments: tall, tousled dark-brown quiff (signature, never covered by default)
muted teal zip-up hooded jacket, worn open, sleeves pushed up slightly
simple white sneakers with one muted red stripe (the single warm accent)

role: panicked (wide eyes, raised brows, small open mouth) for the overflow
relieved (soft smile, lowered brows) after the click
curious (one brow up, small mouth) as the explanation starts
impressed (raised brows, open smile) at the payoff

poses: holding a fuel nozzle in a car's filler neck (arm extended, hand closed around an empty grip)
pointing at something low in front of him
wardrobe: base: modern casual (teal open hoodie-jacket, cream T-shirt, jeans, white sneakers) [this sheet]
1873 Kansas saloon (the planned time-travel story): he arrives in his modern base outfit (the fish-out-of-water joke); a period duster coat and hat are later variants
future historical variants as layers over the same body: period coats, hats, aprons and tools, chosen per story
accessories as separate layers: smartphone, key fob, backpack, cap, sunglasses, period hats
props: fuel nozzle: the episode's 3D hero prop, held in the grip pose; not character artwork
